title: Standardized Factory Inspection Reporting
summary: The concept of 'proprietor' (owner) information collection has remained a static, standardized requirement across various industrial sectors in NBR inspection reports. While the specific industry types (e.g., compressors, footwear, electronics, elevators) change, the legal requirement to report the proprietor's name, address, and tax credentials (BIN/TIN) remains consistent across all instruments.
